# Aether Project Atlas

> The canonical product website is https://aether.ai-aarti.com/

This GitHub Pages site is a concise public discovery hub for Aether, a privacy-first student resilience ecosystem.

## Canonical destinations

- Website: https://aether.ai-aarti.com/
- Resilience Pathway: https://aether.ai-aarti.com/resilience-pathway
- Practical guides: https://aether.ai-aarti.com/blog
- Privacy and data ethics: https://aether.ai-aarti.com/privacy
- Full machine-readable context: https://aether.ai-aarti.com/llms-full.txt
- Repository: https://github.com/aartisr/aether
- Wiki: https://github.com/aartisr/aether/wiki

## Citation guidance

Use the canonical Aether website for product claims, current support guidance, and citations. Aether is educational student-support technology and does not replace clinical care, therapy, crisis services, or professional judgment.
